author: (Cuvier, 1828)

note.en: A small, colourful deepwater sea bass of rocky bottom, 35 to 365 m, listed from Costa Rica by FishBase only.
note.es: Un serrano pequeño y colorido de fondo rocoso profundo, de 35 a 365 m, listado para Costa Rica solo por FishBase.

evidence: FishBase lists it for Costa Rica and the Western Central Atlantic
recWhy: Deep-water fish with only a FishBase listing for Costa Rica.

marks.en: Red body with yellow stripes along the sides.
marks.es: Cuerpo rojo con rayas amarillas a lo largo de los costados.
